dependency_manifest_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2H-C - Research Reproducibility Dependency Manifest

standard_library_core_dependencies.decimal: High-precision arithmetic (Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP) for zero-residual accounting.
standard_library_core_dependencies.hashlib: Cryptographic integrity hashing (SHA-256) for manifests and checkpoint binding.
standard_library_core_dependencies.hmac: Cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 signature verification on activation tokens.
standard_library_core_dependencies.json: Deterministic serialization/deserialization for causal events and evidence ledgers.
standard_library_core_dependencies.math: Floor operations for integer share truncation (no fractional shares).
standard_library_core_dependencies.datetime: Strict UTC ISO-8601 timestamping and temporal sequence ordering.
standard_library_core_dependencies.os_and_sys: Process-level guards, canonical path resolution, and exit code control.

pytest.purpose: Automated regression testing and test discovery.

numpy.purpose: Optional numerical acceleration for synthetic matrix operations.

dependency_design_philosophy.zero_heavy_frameworks: No pandas, scipy, or heavy ML dependencies required in production agent.py or comparator d2.
dependency_design_philosophy.hermetic_reproducibility: All core algorithms run strictly on pure Python 3.11+ standard library, guaranteeing identical execution across Windows, Linux, and macOS.
